coverage: partial planning inventory; not standards certification

reference_snapshot.selection: Numbered published edition; the rolling latest artifact is labeled Bleeding Edge. Edition references are historical mappings, not automatic current-version assertions.

controls.title: Map assets and trust boundaries
controls.next_step: Confirm assets, actors, data flows and trust boundaries with the owner.

controls.title: Review account and session boundaries
controls.next_step: Trace login, recovery and session controls, then test allowed and denied roles.

controls.title: Review ownership and tenant isolation
controls.next_step: Check owner, non-owner and cross-tenant access to the same protected resource.

controls.title: Review sensitive data handling
controls.next_step: Locate sensitive data, access paths, logs, retention and deletion behavior.

controls.title: Review input and output boundaries
controls.next_step: Trace untrusted input to queries, files, requests and rendered output.

controls.title: Review business-state invariants
controls.next_step: Define legitimate state transitions and check retries, ordering and abuse cases.

controls.title: Review dependency and secret boundaries
controls.next_step: Verify the actual lockfiles, dependency identities and credential handling.

controls.title: Review infrastructure permissions and exposure
controls.next_step: Obtain scoped configuration evidence for storage, host and cloud access.

controls.title: Verify artifact and environment correspondence
controls.next_step: Independently identify the deployed artifact; a local commit is insufficient.

controls.title: Review deployed web and API exposure
controls.next_step: Plan explicitly scoped runtime checks; a URL alone is not execution permission.

controls.title: Verify capacity and recovery evidence
controls.next_step: Define workload and recovery expectations before separately authorized tests.

controls.title: Review model, data and tool trust boundaries
controls.next_step: Confirm actual AI use; inspect sensitive context, retrieval and tool permissions.
